doors.heading: Five doors. Pick yours.
doors.sub: Each door leads to a version of CoachOS written for that kind of work.

cards.body: 54% of SMB owners manage marketing alone (BrightLocal SMB Marketing Report 2025). A gym owner writing Sunday posts instead of planning next month's classes.
63% of freelancers cite irregular income as their top challenge (Remote Global Freelancer Report). Finish a project, skip the referral ask, cold-pitch from zero.
72% mentee retention with formal mentoring vs 49% without (Sun Microsystems/Chronus). The gap is structure, a clear offer, and a page worth sending.
122,974 coaches worldwide in a $5.34B industry (ICF Global Coaching Study 2025). Your calendar fills when you market — and you cannot market when it is full.
Only 26% of employees rate company mentoring programs 8/10 or higher (HR.com). Matching lives in spreadsheets; leadership gets satisfaction scores, not proof.

founderSection.heading: Your message lands with me — the founder, not a support queue.
paragraphs: I am Shaikh. Before CoachOS, I worked inside the coaching industry and spent years freelancing — building, marketing, and chasing leads as a one-person shop. CoachOS exists because solo coaches and small businesses should not need three subscriptions, a freelancer, and a stack of Zapier zaps to look professional and keep leads moving.
Everywhere else on this site: AI drafts the work, a specialist reviews it, and it ships under your name. This form skips the AI — you write in, I read it, and I reply.
If your project needs more hands — design, copy, ads — I bring in the right specialists and stay accountable for the result.
